samples.summary: New public bulk-mutation API `unsetRangeStyleValues` carries no read-only/permission awareness; the only gate is in the view wrappers
samples.evidence: `Sheet.unsetRangeStyleValues` (sheet.ts:4287) and `Sheet.changeDecimals` (sheet.ts:4195) perform sheet-wide writes (`store.setSheetStyle`, `setColumnStyle`, `setRowStyle`, `setRangeStyles`, `store.set`/`store.delete` on every matching cell) with no editability check of their own. Enforcement lives only in `Spreadsheet.increaseDecimals`/`decreaseDecimals` (`packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:535` and `:545`, `if (!this.sheet || this._readOnly) return;`). I enumerated all call sites (grep for `changeDecimals|unsetRangeStyleValues` across the repo): only those two view wrappers, `changeDecimals` itself, and `packages/sheets/test/sheet/decimals.test.ts` — so on this branch the gate is not bypassed today. The exposure is that an `all`-selection unset now rewrites/deletes cell records sheet-wide (unlike `setRangeStyle`, whose column/row/all branches never touch cells), so any future entry point (a keyboard shortcut in `view/worksheet.ts`, an embedder holding the exported `Sheet`) that forgets the `_readOnly` check gets a much larger unauthorized write than before. Server-side document authorization (`packages/backend/src/document/yorkie-auth.controller.ts`) is unaffected and still applies, which is why this is hardening rather than a bypass.

samples.summary: In-memory style layers are mutated regardless of whether the persisted write is accepted, so a store that silently refuses writes shows an un-persisted change
samples.evidence: In `unsetRangeStyleValues` the local caches are assigned before/independently of the persisted result: `this.sheetStyle = next` then `await this.store.setSheetStyle(next)` (sheet.ts:4394-4395), and the same for `colStyles` (4406-4407), `rowStyles` (4419-4420) and `rangeStyles` (4442-4443). `ReadOnlyStore` implements every write as a no-op (`packages/sheets/src/store/readonly.ts:43`, "All write operations are no-ops"), so if this path is ever reached with a non-writable store the UI renders formatting as removed while nothing was persisted — a client-side-only view of a write the storage layer rejected. `setRangeStyle` (sheet.ts:3695) already has this pattern, so the diff extends rather than introduces it, and the view-level `_readOnly` gate currently keeps the path unreachable; that is why confidence on exploitability is not high.
searchedFor: read Sheet.setRangeStyle for the existing mutate-then-persist pattern
